senses.definition: n.m. stench—בּ׳ cstr. Am 4:10; sf. בָּאְשׁוֹ Jo 2:20; בָּאְשָׁם Is 34:3;—בּ׳ מַחֲנֵיכֶם, i.e. stench of corpses Am 4:10, also Is 34:3; cf. Jo 2:20 of locusts עָלָה בּ׳ (‖ תַּעַל צַחֲנָתוֹ).
